name: semantic_recall
description: CONCEPTUAL/MEANING search using AI embeddings. Use for abstract questions where you need to match by MEANING rather than exact words. Good for: 'where did I put...', 'what was that thing about...', 'find memories related to...'. Matches concepts even if different words used. If user mentions specific entity/name they want to find, use search_memory instead (faster and more accurate).

query.description: Natural language search query - can be a question or topic

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return
